name: Magnus Lygdback
who: Swedish trainer to A-list actors and musicians; sells the Magnus Method training app with celebrity-style programs.
why: Two decades coaching Ben Affleck, Gal Gadot, Alicia Vikander and others for film roles, now packaged into a consumer app.

name: Don Saladino
who: Celebrity strength coach (Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Sebastian Stan) selling the Don Saladino app with tiered strength programs.
why: Consistent superhero-body client roster plus an app used in 100+ countries; also hosts the Stronger with Don Saladino podcast.

name: Joe Wicks
who: UK's 'Body Coach'; sells The Body Coach subscription app (workout + meal plans), the coaching product behind a household fitness brand.
why: Mass-market UK fitness figure — app has passed 1M downloads and generated over £24M; largest reach in this segment.

name: Jillian Michaels
who: Biggest Loser trainer; sells the award-winning Jillian Michaels Fitness App with structured programs and meal plans.
why: Long-running mainstream celebrity-trainer brand with a genuine app business, not just legacy DVD fame.

name: Hany Rambod
who: Creator of FST-7 training; preps IFBB pros and sells the FST-7 training app plus Evogen Nutrition coaching content to the public.
why: Clients have combined for 25 Olympia titles — the deepest documented pro-physique coaching pedigree in this segment.

name: Kassem Hanson
who: Founder of N1 Training/Education; sells individualized programming courses for trainers and physique-athlete coaching programs.
why: Respected technical voice on exercise selection and individualization, with a scaled education-plus-coaching business.

name: Gunnar Peterson
who: Longtime celebrity trainer (Kardashian-Jenner family, pro athletes) offering online training programs through his own site.
why: One of the longest-running names in celebrity training, with continued reach through A-list clients.

name: Harley Pasternak
who: Celebrity trainer (Halle Berry, Ariana Grande, Rihanna) selling the 5-Factor coaching methodology through books and online programs.
why: Nutrition-science credentials plus a decades-deep celebrity roster distinguish him from pure influencer trainers.

name: Charles Glass
who: Veteran pro-bodybuilding coach who has prepped multiple Mr. Olympia-era champions; sells online coaching and a training-vault app.
why: Among the most respected names in bodybuilding coaching pedigree, still active coaching pros and the public.

name: Chris Aceto
who: Longtime pro-bodybuilding contest-prep coach and nutrition consultant selling 1:1 online prep coaching.
why: Decades of documented contest-prep results with top-level competitors; niche but deeply credentialed.

name: Joe Bennett (Hypertrophy Coach)
who: Physique coach behind the Hypertrophy Coach app, selling structured muscle-building programs and coaching to lifters and athletes.
why: Strong reputation for evidence-informed hypertrophy programming packaged into a scaled coaching app.

name: Paul Revelia
who: Pro Physique competitor and YouTuber selling online contest-prep and physique coaching to amateur competitors.
why: Documentary-style prep content built real coaching-client demand from the physique-competitor audience.

name: Cliff Wilson
who: Natural pro bodybuilder offering online coaching and contest prep to natural bodybuilding clients.
why: One of the most visible natural-pro coaches, with a large following built on transparent, drug-tested competing.

name: Ben Pakulski
who: IFBB pro bodybuilder running MI40/MI40 Nation, a scaled online muscle-building coaching program and trainer-certification business.
why: Blends elite competitive record with a genuinely large scientific-bodybuilding coaching operation, not just content.

name: Milos Sarcev
who: Veteran IFBB pro coach ('Mind Sculpting') who has trained multiple Olympia-level competitors and coaches the public online.
why: Old-school bodybuilding coaching pedigree with a client list spanning multiple eras of pro bodybuilding.

name: Kris Gethin
who: Former Bodybuilding.com head coach; sells extreme-transformation programs through the Kris Gethin Trains app.
why: Built his brand on documented, filmed personal transformations before scaling into a broad online coaching app.

name: Chloe Ting
who: YouTube workout-challenge creator whose paid Chloe Ting app turns her free challenge format into a subscription coaching product.
why: Enormous global reach; passes the gate narrowly on the authored coaching app rather than the free YouTube challenges.

name: Stan Efferding
who: Elite powerlifter and bodybuilder behind the Vertical Diet, selling online nutrition/training consulting to strength and physique athletes.
why: Rare combination of elite competitive record in two sports with a real consulting practice built on it.
